In detail

Rated on the station, because that is the part of it travellers are in. Piazzale XXV Aprile, the forecourt of Verona Porta Nuova, is reported by local outlets and by the transport union FAISA-CISAL as a place where mugging, harassment and dealing happen daily and in the open, and the opposition on the city council has raised it as unaddressed; the Bentegodi stadium area, also here, is inside the Prefettura's zone rosse. The rest of the circoscrizione — Borgo Milano, Saval, Chievo, San Massimo — is ordinary residential suburb and nothing in the sources singles it out. If you are staying by the station, the red is about the forecourt at night, not about the neighbourhood you sleep in.
